hero.title: An Indian virtual number for SMS verification
intro: India is the largest WhatsApp market in the world and one of the biggest user bases for nearly every global platform. Many services ship India-specific versions, tariffs and features — and the key that unlocks them at sign-up is a +91 mobile number.

SMS Code puts a real Indian mobile number in your hands in one tap. Enter it at the verification step, and the SMS — with a code from WhatsApp, Telegram, Google, Instagram or Uber — arrives in the app usually within seconds.

whyCountry.title: Why choose an Indian number?
body: When a platform serves hundreds of millions of Indian users, it often builds a distinct Indian experience: separate app builds, local content libraries, region-locked promotions. A +91 number is how those services decide you belong to that market — useful when you need an account that lives on the Indian side of a platform.

Indian mobile numbers are a flat ten digits after +91, with no area codes to trip over — one of the simplest formats in the world to validate. Given the sheer scale of Indian sign-up traffic, a +91 registration is about as unremarkable as it gets for any global service.

tips.title: The world's biggest WhatsApp market
tips.body: Nowhere on earth uses WhatsApp more than India. If your goal is a WhatsApp account rooted in the Indian market, verifying with a +91 number is the most direct route there is.

tips.title: India-specific apps want Indian numbers
tips.body: Some services offer India-only versions, catalogs or pricing tiers that check your number's country at registration. A +91 number is what routes you into the Indian variant rather than the generic international one.

tips.title: Popular country, fresh numbers
tips.body: Indian numbers are in heavy demand, so occasionally one has already met the service you're verifying. If no SMS arrives, cancellation and number replacement are available two minutes after assignment. The old activation’s coins return to your balance; check the new activation’s price before trying again.

faqs.q: Is it a real Indian mobile number?
faqs.a: Yes — a ten-digit mobile number on a real carrier network behind the +91 code. Services see a regular Indian subscriber, exactly like the hundreds of millions already registered with them.

faqs.q: What do people verify with a +91 number most?
faqs.a: WhatsApp above all — India is its largest market — followed by Telegram, Google, Instagram and Uber, all of which have enormous Indian user bases and smooth +91 sign-up flows.

faqs.q: Do I have to be in India to receive the code?
faqs.a: No. The number exists in the SMS Code app rather than in a SIM slot, so your location is irrelevant — the verification SMS reaches you anywhere in the world.

faqs.q: Why would I want the Indian version of an app?
faqs.a: Platforms sometimes tie content, pricing or features to the country of your account, and the phone number is one of the signals they use. An Indian number lets you register on the Indian side of that divide when that's the version you need.

faqs.q: Can I keep using the number after verification?
faqs.a: The rental spans the activation window, which is designed for receiving the code. For accounts you'll keep, set up a recovery email and authenticator-based 2FA immediately so the account no longer depends on the number.
